As Abbvie (ABBV) Valuation Declined, Shareholder Atlanta Capital Group Has Increased Its Stake; As Caterpillar (CAT) Market Valuation Declined, Busey Trust Company Has Upped by $4.62 Million Its Position
May 25, 2018 - By Hazel Jackson
Busey Trust Company increased its stake in Caterpillar Inc (CAT) by 95.1% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Busey Trust Company bought 29,415 shares as the company’s stock declined 5.62% with the market. The institutional investor held 60,347 shares of the capital goods company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $9.51M, up from 30,932 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Busey Trust Company who had been investing in Caterpillar Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $94.29 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.03% or $0.04 during the last trading session, reaching $157.7. About 2.89 million shares traded. Caterpillar Inc. (NYSE:CAT) has risen 60.63% since May 25, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 49.08% the S&P500.
Atlanta Capital Group increased its stake in Abbvie Inc (ABBV) by 18.59% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Atlanta Capital Group bought 5,272 shares as the company’s stock declined 6.31% with the market. The institutional investor held 33,629 shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.25M, up from 28,357 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Atlanta Capital Group who had been investing in Abbvie Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $163.67 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 2.33% or $2.46 during the last trading session, reaching $103.14. About 13.16 million shares traded or 80.46% up from the average. AbbVie Inc. (NYSE:ABBV) has risen 39.20% since May 25, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 27.65% the S&P500.
